question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "who."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The reason to use **"who" **in the blank is to introduce a relative clause that specifies more information about the people being referred to. ((व्‍यक्ति का नाम आदि पूछने के लिए प्रश्‍नसूचक वाक्‍यों में प्रयुक्त), कौन?)
 
• In this case, it provides additional information about the group of people who find the situation discouraging – specifically, those who love to wear earrings.
 
• **"Who" **is used to connect the clause to the noun **"us"** and adds a descriptive detail about the individuals facing the discouragement.
 
• The correct answer is option 3.

 

Correct paragraph: 

Metal allergies can begin to act up within__ minutes of putting earrings in your ears. Some people can go a few hours before having to __take__ the earrings out, but some can barely stand the __discomfort__ enough to bother putting earrings in at all. This can be discouraging for those of us __**who**__ love to wear earrings, but fortunately hypoallergenic jewellery for ______ (5) ______ ears exists! 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Which: **used in questions to ask somebody to be exact, when there are a number of people or things to choose from. ((अनेक व्‍यक्तियों या वस्‍तुओं में बिल्‍कुल सही को चुनने के लिए प्रयुक्त) कौन-सा?)
 
• **That: **used to introduce a restrictive (essential) relative clause.** "That"** helps define or identify the noun it modifies. (वह (वक्ता से दूर स्थित किसीव्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु का निर्देश करने के लिए प्रयुक्त))
 
• **Whom: **used instead of ‘who’ as the object of a verb or preposition. (जिसे, जिसको (पूर्वसर्ग या किसी के कर्म के रूप में ‘who’ के स्‍थान पर प्रयुक्त))
